profile_text.body:
Datadog, Inc. is a public company headquartered in New York, NY, trading under the ticker DDOG and also listed as DATADOG INC - CLASS A. Its SEC Central Index Key is 0001561550. On its own site the company describes itself as offering cloud monitoring as a service, letting users see metrics from all of their apps, tools and services in one place, with a free trial available.

The site also frames security as part of its pitch, describing integration of security and observability as a way for organizations to defend against AI-powered attacks. In that framing, the company says such integration lets organizations decode runtime execution, eliminate exposure in dynamic AI environments, and carry out detection and response with agentic speed.

Beyond that, the record holds no products, no MCP servers, and no lawsuits for the company. Its recorded litigation exposure is in New York, with a count of 458.
